title: OperatorMessageRequest
description: A durable provider-neutral request to deliver content to an operator.

requestId.description: Stable identity of the original request.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key resolving retries to the original request.

principalRef.description: Stable reference to the requesting principal.

requestedAt.description: Time at which the request was created.

expiresAt.description: Optional absolute deadline after which the request is rejected.

purpose.description: Bounded machine-readable reason for the message.

content.description: Exactly one scrubbed inline body or bounded journal artifact reference.

text.description: Inline content scrubbed by the journal boundary.

size.description: Required content bound for an operator message artifact.
